headline: Jefferies Upgrades Rivian to Buy, Citing Recent Sell-Off as Entry Point
summary: Jefferies upgraded Rivian stock to Buy, viewing the recent market sell-off as an attractive entry point for investors.
why: Analyst rating upgrades can alter institutional sentiment and drive buying interest in high-growth automotive and technology equities.

impacts.name: Rivian Automotive Inc
impacts.why: Brokerage upgrades often attract fresh investment capital and improve short-term stock performance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An analyst upgrade identifying discounted share prices following a sell-off drew institutional buying interest.
